story.text: 팬사인회에 다녀온 지도, 콘서트를 보러 갔던 것도 이제는 꽤 지난 일이 되었다. 그런데도 하늘의 마음은 여전히 그 자리에 머물러 있었다.
story.reading: paen-sa-in-hoe-e da-nyeo-on ji-do, kon-seo-teu-reul bo-reo gass-deon geot-do i-je-neun kkwae ji-nan il-i doe-eoss-da. geu-reon-de-do ha-neul-ui ma-eum-eun yeo-jeon-hi geu ja-ri-e meo-mul-leo iss-eoss-da.
story.en: It had been a while since the fan-signing, longer still since the concert. And yet, Haneul's feelings had stayed rooted right where they'd started.

story.text: 처음엔 분명 팬으로서의 호기심이었다. 그런데 어느새, 그는 그녀가 무대 위에 있을 때보다 이렇게 마주 앉아 있는 순간을 더 기다리고 있었다.
story.reading: cheo-eum-en bun-myeong paen-eu-ro-seo-ui ho-gi-sim-i-eoss-da. geu-reon-de eo-neu-sae, geu-neun geu-nyeo-ga mu-dae wi-e iss-eul ttae-bo-da i-reoh-ge ma-ju anj-a it-neun sun-gan-eul deo gi-da-ri-go iss-eoss-da.
story.en: At first, it had clearly been fan-like curiosity. But at some point along the way, he found himself looking forward to moments like this — just sitting across from her — more than any moment of her up on stage.

story.text: '…솔직히 말할게요.' 하늘이 드물게 먼저 입을 열었다. '저, 팬이 아니게 된 지, 꽤 오래전 같아요.'
story.reading: '…sol-jik-hi mal-hal-ge-yo.' ha-neul-i deu-mul-ge meon-jeo ib-eul yeol-eoss-da. 'jeo, paen-i a-ni-ge doen ji, kkwae o-rae-jeon gat-a-yo.'
story.en: '...I'll be honest with you.' Haneul spoke first, which was rare for him. 'I think I stopped being just a fan — a while ago now. A good while.'

story.text: '언제부터 달라졌는지는 정확히 모르겠어요. 팬사인회였는지, 콘서트였는지, 아니면 그보다 훨씬 전이었는지.'
story.reading: 'eon-je-bu-teo dal-la-jyeoss-neun-ji-neun jeong-hwag-hi mo-reu-gess-eo-yo. paen-sa-in-hoe-yeoss-neun-ji, kon-seo-teu-yeoss-neun-ji, a-ni-myeon geu-bo-da hwol-ssin jeon-i-eoss-neun-ji.'
story.en: 'I don't know exactly when it changed. Whether it was the fan-signing, or the concert, or something even earlier than that.'

story.text: 스스로도 놀랄 만큼 순순히 인정하는 자신이 낯설었다. 원래라면 절대 먼저 이런 말을 꺼낼 사람이 아니었으니까.
story.reading: seu-seu-ro-do nol-lal man-keum sun-sun-hi in-jeong-ha-neun ja-sin-i nach-seol-eoss-da. won-lae-ra-myeon jeol-dae meon-jeo i-reon mal-eul kkeo-nael sa-ram-i a-ni-eoss-eu-ni-kka.
story.en: Even he was surprised at how easily he'd admitted it. He wasn't the type who ever brought something like this up first, not normally.

story.text: '이거 하나는 확실해요. 지금 저한테 손님은, 그냥 손님이 아니에요. 그리고 어느 유명한 사람도 아니고요.'
story.reading: 'i-geo ha-na-neun hwag-sil-hae-yo. ji-geum jeo-han-te son-nim-eun, geu-nyang son-nim-i a-ni-e-yo. geu-ri-go eo-neu yu-myeong-han sa-ram-do a-ni-go-yo.'
story.en: 'One thing is certain, though. To me, right now, you're not just a passenger. And you're not some famous stranger, either.'

story.text: 말을 마친 하늘의 귀는 이미 새빨갛게 물들어 있었다. 그런데도 그는 시선을 피하지 않았다. 오랜만에, 아주 오랜만에.
story.reading: mal-eul ma-chin ha-neul-ui gwi-neun i-mi sae-ppal-gat-ge mul-deul-eo iss-eoss-da. geu-reon-de-do geu-neun si-seon-eul pi-ha-ji anh-ass-da. o-raen-man-e, a-ju o-raen-man-e.
story.en: By the time he finished speaking, Haneul's ears had already gone bright red. And yet, this time, he didn't look away. For the first time in a long, long while.

words.example_en: Before he knew it, his feelings had changed.
He quietly admitted his true feelings.
His feelings had already been decided a while ago.
This feeling, at least, was certain.

sentences.en: Before he knew it, his feelings had changed completely.
He admitted his true feelings for the first time.
His feelings had already been settled a while ago.
This one feeling, at least, was certain.
